title: 赛博永生工作室
voice: 欢迎来到我的赛博永生工作室。把脑洞存档，把想法变成能探索的小宇宙。
voiceEn: Welcome to my Cyber Eternal Studio: a place to archive wild ideas and turn them into a little world you can explore.

title: 一个会生长的小宇宙
voice: 招财猫会摇手，项目在贩卖机里悬浮。每一件作品，都能打开自己的故事。
voiceEn: The lucky cat waves. Projects levitate inside a vending machine. Every object opens a story of its own.

title: 从一张图，开始造物
voice: 用 Tripo AI，从清晰的主体参考图，或一段文字出发，开始生成三维资产。
titleEn: From one image to a 3D world
voiceEn: Start with Tripo AI. Upload a clear reference image, or describe your idea in text, and begin creating a 3D asset.

title: 上传。生成。检查。导出。
voice: 上传图片，选择精度或拓扑，生成后旋转检查，再导出适合网页的 GLB。
voiceEn: Upload an image, choose detail or topology, inspect the generated model from every angle, then export a GLB for the web.

title: 先探索，再选择你的方案
voice: 免费版每月二百点。Pro 月付二十美元。API 另外计费，额外处理按用量计算。
voiceEn: The free plan includes two hundred credits a month. Pro costs twenty US dollars monthly. API credits are billed separately, with additional processing charged by usage.

title: 让模型，成为空间的一部分
voice: 再用 Blender 整理比例和摆放，用 Three.js 接上灯光与交互。工具和设备，也成为工作室的一部分。
voiceEn: Arrange scale and placement in Blender. Add lighting and interaction with Three.js. The tools and machines become part of the studio.

title: 每个项目，都有自己的入口
voice: 机器人、灵巧手、黑客松。项目与工具介绍会持续更新，这座车间也会和我一起成长。
titleEn: Every project has its own doorway
voiceEn: Robots, dexterous hands, and hackathons. I will keep adding projects and tool guides, so this workshop keeps growing with me.

title: 背面，留一个到此一游
voice: 绕到背面，留下一张照片、一句话，或一个愿望。审核之后，你的到此一游，也会成为这里的记忆。
titleEn: Leave a trace on the back wall
voiceEn: Walk around the back. Leave a photo, a message, or a wish. After review, your visit becomes part of this studio's shared memory.

title: 让你的品牌，亮在这里
voice: 看见头顶的霓虹广告牌了吗？我正在招募核心、硬件和社区赞助商，让品牌走进这座赛博工作室。
titleEn: Put your brand in the spotlight
voiceEn: See that neon billboard? I am looking for core, hardware, and community sponsors to become part of this cyber workshop.

title: 核心赞助 · 按页与档期投放
voice: 核心赞助按轮播页和时间计费，五十元每月起。标志可以跳转官网，合作确认后按档期展示。
titleEn: Core sponsorship by page and period
voiceEn: Core sponsorship is priced by rotating page and campaign period, from fifty renminbi a month. Logos link to your website, with approved campaigns shown on schedule.

title: 产品，也可以有自己的赛博展位
voice: 硬件供应商，也可以拥有赛博展位。比如 PLAUD NotePin S，用三维展示连接真实场景与后续测评。
titleEn: Give your product a cyber booth
voiceEn: Hardware suppliers can have a cyber booth too. Imagine PLAUD NotePin S on the shelf, connecting a 3D showcase with real workflows and a future review.

title: 把天马行空，收拢成开发计划
voice: 我想用它记录黑客松会议和发散的灵感，由 AI 整理需求和开发规格，再交给 WorkBuddy、Cursor 或 Codex。这是接下来要实测的工作流。
titleEn: Turn scattered ideas into a spec
voiceEn: I want to capture hackathon meetings and scattered ideas, let AI distill requirements and a development spec, then bring them into WorkBuddy, Cursor, or Codex. This is a workflow I plan to test.

title: 最近，有活动要宣传吗？
voice: 展位、工作坊、发布会或周边合作，都欢迎来聊。Makers Challenge 独立企划，也在寻找合作伙伴。
voiceEn: Planning a workshop, launch, booth, or swag collaboration? Let's talk. Our independent Makers Challenge proposal is also looking for partners.

title: 把合作，变成可执行的档期
voice: 从广告牌进入申请，提交标志、官网和档期。我会审核并确认合作，目前先人工沟通，不自动扣款。
titleEn: Turn a partnership into a campaign
voiceEn: Open the billboard application. Submit your logo, website, and preferred dates. I review and confirm each collaboration. Payment is currently handled manually.

title: 下一件，一起造。
voice: 从一张图，到一座工作室。从一个人的脑洞，到更多人的共创。来逛逛，也一起造点东西。
titleEn: Let's build the next thing together
voiceEn: From an image to a studio. From one person's imagination to a shared creation. Come explore Peter Pan's Techland, and let's build the next thing together.
